API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIDevice GroupsDevice Group Resource Get Devices Lite
Device Group Resource Get Devices Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/deviceGroups/devices/lite

Gets a list of devices that includes device ID, name, and owner name. Any given search parameters are applied during device search. Search parameters are based on device or user name and owner. The devices listed can also be restricted to return information only for ones belonging to specific users.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
name
string

The device group name.

userIds
int32[]

Used to list devices for specific users.

includeAll
boolean

Used to include or exclude Cloud Browser Isolation devices.

Default value: false
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifier for the device.

name
string

The device name.

deviceGroupType
string

The device group type.

Possible values: [ZCC_OS, NON_ZCC, CBI]

deviceModel
string

The device model.

osType
string

The operating system (OS).

Possible values: [ANY, OTHER_OS, IOS, ANDROID_OS, WINDOWS_OS, MAC_OS, LINUX]

osVersion
string

The operating system version.

description
string

The device's description.

ownerUserId
int32

The unique identifier of the device owner (i.e., user).

ownerName
string

The device owner's user name.

hostName
string

The hostname of the device.

]
